title: Frequently Asked Questions
description: Select a category to find answers to common questions.

start.a1: MotivBuy is a marketplace for buying and selling Telegram channel subscribers. You can grow your channel by purchasing real subscribers, or earn money by selling traffic from your bots.
start.a2:
1. Top up your balance
2. Add your channel as a target
3. Create an order specifying how many subscribers you need
4. Wait for subscribers to arrive (usually within 24 hours)
start.a3: Yes! All subscribers are real Telegram users. We don't use bots or fake accounts. Your channel remains safe and compliant with Telegram's terms.

orders.q1: How do I create an order?
orders.a1: Go to "Buy Traffic" → Add your channel → Set the number of subscribers you want → Confirm and pay. That's it!
orders.a2: Most orders are completed within 24 hours. Speed depends on order size and current demand. You can track progress in real-time.
orders.a3: The minimum order is 100 subscribers. There's no maximum limit.
orders.q4: Can I cancel or pause an order?
orders.a4: Yes! You can pause or cancel an active order anytime. Unused funds will be refunded to your balance.
orders.a5:
New orders go through a quick moderation check (usually 5-15 minutes). If it's taking longer, check that:
• Your balance is sufficient
• The channel/group is accessible
• The price per subscriber isn't too low

balance.a1: Go to Balance → Deposit → Choose your payment method (crypto, card, or e-wallet) → Follow the instructions.
balance.a2:
We accept:
• Cryptocurrency (BTC, ETH, USDT)
• Bank cards (Visa, MasterCard)
• E-wallets

Crypto deposits are usually fastest.
balance.q3: How do I withdraw my earnings?
balance.a3: Go to Balance → Withdraw → Select amount and method. Minimum withdrawal is $10. Processing takes up to 24 hours.
balance.q4: Why is my deposit not showing?
balance.a4: Crypto deposits require network confirmations (usually 1-3). Card payments are instant. If it's been more than 1 hour, contact support.
balance.a5: Deposits are free. Withdrawals have a small network/processing fee depending on the method (typically 1-2%).

traffic.q1: How do I earn by selling traffic?
traffic.a1: Add your bot as a traffic source → It will display ads to users → You earn for each subscriber delivered. Earnings are automatic!
traffic.a2: Rates are $0.01-0.05 per subscriber, depending on traffic quality. High-quality, active audiences earn more.
traffic.a3:
Your bot must:
• Be active with real users
• Follow advertising guidelines
• Maintain good traffic quality
• Have you as the owner
traffic.a4: Earnings are credited to your balance instantly after each successful subscriber delivery. Withdraw anytime!

technical.a1:
Try:
1. Send /start to restart
2. Clear chat history and try again
3. Check if Telegram has any outages
4. Contact support if issue persists
technical.a2:
Make sure:
• You're the channel owner or admin
• The channel is not private (or use the channel ID)
• Our bot (@motivbuy_bot) is added as admin with "Add Members" permission
technical.a3:
Check if:
• Your order is still active (not paused)
• Your balance is sufficient
• The channel is still accessible
• The order hasn't reached its limit
technical.a4: Please report it via Support → Report Issue. Include what happened, when, and any error messages. Screenshots help!
